points.text: No control fine-tuning same base on STP/BFS-Prover-style or Mathlib data at equal size
No ablation of constrained tactic decoding versus plain beam exploration
No ablation of pruning (α, β, γ)
No ablation of tactic-set size
No data-scaling curve; 'scalable' claim unsupported

Synthesis compute never reported; lower cost than EI asserted
Adaptive beam hyperparameters tuned per benchmark without validation split
Adaptive vs best fixed beam gain within noise
No sensitivity analysis for λ, Bmin, Bmax or simple tuned fixed beam

ProofNet and MiniF2F gaps within noise; seed counts and ± undefined
SOTA claim omits recent stepwise and MCTS/value-guided provers

BLEU-only decontamination with no threshold, counts or semantic check

Mixing with Mathlib data means not fully synthetic
Section 4.3 narrative; claims and scoring discussion lack controlled experiments or numbers

Cannot produce problems harder than seeds, undercutting scaling claim

No analysis of which problem types benefit
